描述_EN: the 350 deities depicted represent the gods of the daoist pantheon, including the three purities, the three celestial worthies and the jade emperor. it would have rested on the shoulders of the daoist priest, and when he held up his arms, its decorative scheme would have been seen in all its glory by the onlookers. this sumptuous robe made for use in daoist religious ceremonies is embroidered with 350 deities and immortals. this is a 'robe of descent' - square in shape, sleeveless, with a round hole for the neck. originally, many of these personages had their names written beside them, but these have now largely worn away.
描述_ZN: 描绘的350个神灵代表了道教万神殿的神灵，包括三清、三仙和玉皇大帝。 它本来是放在道士的肩膀上的，当他举起手臂的时候，它的装饰方案就会被围观的人看到。 这件华美的袍子是为道教的宗教仪式而制作的，上面绣有350个神灵和仙人。 这是一件 "后裔长袍"--呈方形，无袖，颈部有一个圆孔。 最初，这些人物的旁边都写有他们的名字，但现在这些名字已经基本被磨掉了。
